title: Saws
subtitle: How you cut blocks
text:
Craft an Iron Saw or a Diamond Saw, then put the saw in a crafting grid with one block, or with a piece you have already cut. The saw stays in the grid and loses 1 durability per cut. Each cut gives 2 pieces.

The Iron Saw lasts 250 cuts. The Diamond Saw lasts 1561 cuts. Obsidian, ancient debris and other blocks that need a diamond tool need the Diamond Saw, and so do pieces cut from them.
